writer.short_answer: Three conversations led South African social this week: pap and gravy duets, taxi rank playlists and run club mornings.

claims.text: Pap and gravy duets: the biggest conversation of the week, a food challenge where one person stirs and the other seasons, with 187 posts from 96 creators on 3 platforms.
claims.label: corroborated

claims.text: Pap and gravy duets: posts about it went from 9 on the first day of the week to 31 on the last day.
claims.label: observed

claims.text: Pap and gravy duets: posts present it as a two person challenge where one stirs and the other seasons, which makes it easy to join.
claims.label: single_source

claims.text: Taxi rank playlists: the second conversation, with 142 posts from 81 creators on 3 platforms.
claims.label: corroborated

claims.text: Taxi rank playlists: posts say drivers keep asking for the playlist to be played again.
claims.label: single_source

quotes.text: the driver just asked me to play it again

claims.text: Run club mornings: the third conversation, with 98 posts from 64 creators on 3 platforms.
claims.label: corroborated

quotes.text: 5 am run club is full again

claims.text: Each of the three lives on TikTok and one other platform, and the duets and the playlists are mostly TikTok while the run club is mostly Instagram.
claims.label: corroborated

so_what.text: A food brand can join the duets by lending a sauce, not a script.
A transport or music brand can sponsor a playlist drop at a rank.
A sports or health brand can host a morning run.

question: What's South African social actually talking about this week, outside the election and sport? Give me the three conversations with the most momentum right now and show me the posts that prove it.
